title: Save estimates with a full scope-of-work write-up
body: A detailed scope narrative on an estimate line used to be refused with a confusing 'needs a valid description' error, because QuickBooks only takes 4,000 characters per line. Long write-ups now flow onto extra text rows on the QuickBooks document automatically — the customer sees the whole scope, totals are unchanged, and the same works on invoices. If a line genuinely has a problem, the error now says which line and what to fix.
